notes.title: Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40089782/f5ab11e5249ae8309c9610bdfc449299bf6cdb77.png[/img]


My game is registered for the Steam Next Fest on June 16, 2021! You can test the demo of my game from June 16-22. there will be 10 levels that you can play in the demo!
